admin.project-reigns.help: Kingdom administration (permission level 3): /reigns admin list [page]; info <kingdom>; tp <kingdom>; unclaim <kingdom> <chunkX> <chunkZ> [dimension]; rename <kingdom> <newName>; help. Use a complete UUID or full kingdom name; quote names containing spaces. Unclaim defaults to the command source dimension. Deletion: delete <kingdom>, then delete <kingdom> confirm <token> within 30 seconds. Inspect cities: settlements [page], settlement <UUID>. Cancel: delete <kingdom> cancel <token>. Repeating a request keeps its original deadline; cancel before choosing another target.
